label: Social construction of actually true contents in scope
term: Social construction of actually true contents in scope
definition: Every content in the supplied scope that holds at the actual attitude profile is classified as socially constructed by the supplied construction predicate. The classifier is a primitive representing a selected account of social provenance or convention.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. A socially established vocabulary may express a content that holds regardless of vocabulary use. A sociologically constituted institutional fact, such as a currency being accepted in a polity, may instead fail under a different profile. Which social origin or convention counts as construction is left open.
